'''Farana''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[near-Human]] [[Ocsin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Never governed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], by [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]] it was situated at the endpoint of the [[Morellian Trail]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].

==Description==
Farana was a foggy terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Farana system/Legends|Farana system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> region also known as [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana]].<ref name="CSWE Farana">{{CSWECite|I|254|Farana}}</ref> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Tertiary Etti Route]], which linked it to the [[Hull's Star system/Legends|Hull's Star system]] as well as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ocsin system/Legends|Ocsin system]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route traveled eastward from Farana.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Morellian_Trail.png|thumb|right|250px|By 3705 BBY, Farana served as the endpoint of the Morellian Trail hyperlane.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Farana was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3000 BBY]]. By [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], the world was situated at the endpoint of the hyperlane known as the [[Morellian Trail]], which connected it to the Outer Rim's [[Cadomai system/Legends|Cadomai system]]. That route was integrated into the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] at some point following [[3694 BBY]], although the latter no longer traveled to Farana, instead terminating at the [[Bonadan system/Legends|Bonadan system]]. While Farana was situated at the border of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> it was never ruled by either that government or its successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EotE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Farana was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ocsin]], a clan-based [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and explorers which dominated the Farana region and established extensive ties between it and the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] via trade and migration. The Ocsin were believed to have ultimately originated from the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the Outer Rim's [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Farana [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered between one and ten billion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Farana was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
